description: Get top cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap. Returns rank, name, symbol, USD price, market cap, 24h volume, and 24h % change for each.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CoinPaprika Pro API key for a dedicated quota (uses the api-pro endpoint). Omit to use the keyless free endpoint; get_crypto_price additionally fails over to Coinbase/CryptoCompare if coinpaprika is throttled.

limit.description: Number of coins to return (1-100, default 10)

name: get_crypto_market
